title: Layout Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the 📏️layout plugin (single app "layout", single artifact "layout") from its old 7-crate constitutional layout into ONE crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📏️layout/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ with the full taxonomy source tree, per the master ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE's TEMPLATE.md recipe. This is W2 batch-2 work. Exclusive file ownership: everything under ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📏️layout/**. Preserve crate name semio-s-plugin-layout and all [package.metadata.*] verbatim. Old ui crate has the known systemic pre-existing broken-parens bug (Ok( without closing paren in handle() match arms) — fix as natural side effect of app_commands! decomposition. Verify with cargo check (native+wasm32-wasip2), clippy -D warnings, cargo test, wire-format diff proof, then report registrar handoff (do not edit root Cargo.toml/registry/launch.json myself).
summary: Migrated the 📏️layout plugin (single app, single artifact) from its old 7-crate constitutional layout into ONE crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📏️layout/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ (semio-s-plugin-layout) with the full taxonomy tree, per TEMPLATE.md. All verification passed in isolation via the temporary workspace overlay (removed at handoff): cargo check native + wasm32-wasip2 clean, clippy -D warnings clean, cargo test 116/116 passing (exceeds the 50-test correctness floor from the 6 old crates that actually compiled — the 7th, the old ui crate, never compiled at HEAD due to the systemic pre-existing broken-parens bug, confirmed and fixed as a natural side effect of app_commands! decomposition), wire-format byte-identical proof captured before/after (28 representative command values, saved in this ticket's 🧪️wire-baseline-before.txt/🧪️wire-baseline-after.txt). Also relocated the orphan sample-manifest data file to 🗿️artifacts/📏️layout/🛂️manifest.json, and repointed the one cross-cutting dependent (🧪️fixture-sweep) from the deleted semio-s-app-layout facade crate to layout::artifacts::layout::LayoutDocument on semio-s-plugin-layout. Fixed two genuine pre-existing manifest gaps that the never-compiling old ui crate had hidden: missing mandatory `.document([...])` builder call (framework asserts non-empty segments) and a test that wrongly assumed every wire keyword is the kebab-cased command id (layout's `set*` view commands deliberately drop the `set-` prefix in their wire key, unlike flow). Did not touch root Cargo.toml, registry script, launch.json, or any other plugin's directory — registrar handoff reported separately.
